prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Personalize Your Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Customize your pet's official birth certificate before bringing them to your desktop.", "Give your pet a name"]
1: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Click and drag to move your pet anywhere. Right-click anytime for controls, hiding options, and voice commands.", "Master basic controls and shortcut menus"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Pick preset characters or create a custom pet from photos."]
3: ["Upload Photos for Custom Pet Generation", "Clear, well-lit photos produce the best custom 3D pet models.", "Checking Photo Quality", "We are verifying lighting and clarity to ensure your pet generates accurately.", "Analyzing facial features and resolution...", "Quality Check Active"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Forever", "Link your account now to ensure your newly adopted pet, accessories, and progress are saved safely.", "Your pet progress will be securely attached to this account."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Deployment", "Initializing desktop rendering engine and animation loops...", "Building 3D pet assets...", "Estimated time: 30s"]
6: ["Claim Your Free Welcome Pet Toy!", "Finish setup now to unlock an exclusive interactive toy for your desktop pet.", "Free Gift: Interactive Toy Unlocked", "Claim Toy & Meet Pet"]
7: ["Select Your Ideal Companion", "Swipe through available species and personalities.", "Each companion has unique desktop animations and interactive responses!"]
8: ["Feel free to minimize! We will notify you as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop.", "Background Preparation Active"]
9: ["Verify Desktop Appearance & Start Interacting", "Confirm your pet is visible on your screen and configure your starting audio settings.", "Pet visible on screen"]

verdicts.problem: Promotes free gifts and extra incentives to rush setup
